data.name: OtelRequestNote

data.name: OtelDiagnosticsLine
data.value: {0}: received {1} points · stored {2} observations · baseline {3} · duplicate {4} · reset/overlap {5} · rejected {6} · ignored {7} · request logs {8} · no increment {9}

data.name: OtelDiagnosticsAbsent
data.value: Request logs exist, but this metric was not received

data.name: OtelDiagnosticsReportHeader
data.value: Receipt window {0:MM-dd HH:mm:ss} — {1:MM-dd HH:mm:ss} (local); 5-minute granularity, retained 7 days. received=incoming points; stored=committed observations; baseline=first cumulative point; duplicate=retransmission; discontinuity=counter reset/overlap; empty=no increment; ignored=unselected/no recorded value; rejected=whole packet rejected. Points are exported points, observations are committed increments only. Received is receipt time, event is the reported event/export end time. Metric names and reasons use original identifiers; no raw content is stored.

data.name: OtelServerMetricNotExported
data.value: WebSocket timing events arrived, but this metric was not exported to the receiver. Event counts cannot distinguish missing server values from missing client export; true service TBT cannot be reconstructed.

data.name: OtelServerTimingNotReceived
data.value: WebSocket events arrived without timing events or this service metric. Client token intervals are not a substitute.

data.name: OtelServerTransportUnconfirmed
